name: amy-lm-prosody-validation-benchmark-ultra
description: A validation benchmark focused on prosody modeling that measures a model's ability to predict or generate prosodic features (pitch, energy, duration) for spoken utterances. It is intended to evaluate prosody-aware language or speech models on prediction/regression of prosodic contours and/or classification of prosodic patterns. The dataset is used to validate prosody generation quality and alignment with reference recordings.
evaluation_method: MSE / correlation (and optionally human_eval for perceived quality)
general_score_metric: mean_squared_error (with correlation coefficients as complementary metrics)
reputation: A niche Hugging Face-hosted prosody validation set with limited but useful adoption among speech/prosody researchers and developers.
